JaVale McGee is the starting center for the University of Nevada. After his sophomore campaign, McGee decided to hire an agent and declare for the [[2008 NBA Draft]]. His father, George Montgomery, played basketball professionally for the [[Portland Trail Blazers]]. Also his mother, [[Pamela McGee]], was a USC standout and [[WNBA]] star.
